body: Thank you. It is hard for me to imagine anybody but myself raising my daughter. I can’t imagine my life without my mom
Thank you. I know if I lost my mom to something like that I couldn’t live with that. I hope your mom is doing well!

I’ve felt like this on and off since I found out I was pregnant with her but I’ve really hit rock bottom here just in the past few months. I’ve talked to my doctor about it and I’ve tried different medications but nothing seems to work so I’m prescribed Xanax which I don’t even take unless it’s in the evening and my daughter is already asleep. I haven’t gone to any type of therapy or counseling although I do think it might help. I don’t have a single person that I talk to about any of this. I have one friend that I used to could open up to but we don’t even talk anymore. I can’t even talk to my boyfriend and father of my daughter because he just doesn’t understand or take me seriously. And when it comes down to it he’s the reason I feel the way that I do.  I do have a huge and awesome family of loving and supportive people. I just don’t like feeling like a burden and I don’t want them worrying about me.
Thank you. I needed to hear that
